item.title: National Assembly passes parliamentary probe into election commission… 45-day investigation into ballot shortage (선관위 국정조사 국회 통과... 투표용지 부족 45일간 진상규명)
item.description:
National Assembly passes parliamentary probe into election commission… 45-day investigation into ballot shortage (선관위 국정조사 국회 통과... 투표용지 부족 45일간 진상규명)

The ruling and opposition parties passed a parliamentary investigation plan on the 18th at a plenary session of the National Assembly to look into the ballot paper shortage that occurred during the June 3 local elections. The motion was approved with 250 in favor and 1 against out of 251 lawmakers present. Independent lawmaker Choi Hyuk-jin was the sole dissenting vote. (여야는 18일 국회 본회의에서 6·3 지방선거에서 벌어진 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사하는 국정조사 계획서를 처리했다. 재석 251명 중 찬성 250명, 반대 1명으로 의결됐다. 무소속 최혁진 의원이 유일하게 반대표를 던졌다.)

The official title is the “Parliamentary Investigation for the Fact-Finding of Violations of Citizens' Suffrage Rights, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and for Electoral Management Reform.” The investigation period spans 45 days from today until August 1, with the possibility of extension through a plenary vote if necessary. (정식 명칭은 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사’다. 조사 기간은 이날부터 8월 1일까지 45일이고, 필요할 경우 본회의 의결로 활동 기간을 연장할 수 있게 했다.)

The target agencies under investigation include the National Election Commission and all levels of election commissions. Witnesses and reference persons will be determined by agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun of the People Power Party will chair the committee, while lawmaker Yoon Gun-young of the Democratic Party of Korea and lawmaker Seo Beom-soo of the People Power Party will serve as secretaries. (조사 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회 및 각급 선관위로 정리됐다. 증인 및 참고인은 여야 합의로 정해질 예정이다. 국민의힘 윤상현 의원이 위원장을 맡고 더불어민주당 윤건영 의원, 국민의힘 서범수 의원이 간사를 맡는다.)

The ruling and opposition parties also stipulated in the plan that the government and related agencies, organizations, corporations, and individuals cannot refuse to cooperate with the investigation or decline to submit materials on the grounds of criminal investigations or trials. (여야는 또 계획서에서 정부와 관련 기관·단체·법인·개인 등이 수사와 재판을 이유로 조사에 응하지 않거나 자료 제출을 거부할 수 없다고 명시했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Bows 90 Degrees to President Lee... "A World-Class Leader" (정청래, 李대통령에 90도 인사... 의총에선 “월드클래스 지도자”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Bows 90 Degrees to President Lee... "A World-Class Leader" (정청래, 李대통령에 90도 인사... 의총에선 “월드클래스 지도자”)

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 18th, "Now is the time for the party, government, and presidential office to unite tightly and actively participate in President Lee Jae-myung's efforts for the settlement of peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "Let's unite and work together in solidarity around President Lee Jae-myung to vigorously advance the clock of peace on the Korean Peninsula." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 18일 “당정청이 똘똘 뭉쳐서 한반도 평화 정착과 번영을 위한 이재명 대통령의 노력에 적극 동참해야 할 때”라며 “한반도 평화의 시계를 힘차게 돌려나갈 수 있도록 이재명 대통령을 중심으로 똘똘 뭉쳐 합심 단결 합심 노력하자”고 했다.)

Chairman Jung made these remarks during the party's general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly, stating, "We must do everything we can at the National Assembly and party levels for the settlement of peace on the Korean Peninsula and the stability of state affairs." (정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 의원총회에서 “한반도 평화 정착과 국정 안정을 위하여 국회 차원에서 당 차원에서 할 수 있는 모든 일을 다해야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

On this day, Chairman Jung attended a welcoming event for President Lee Jae-myung, who had returned from a European tour, and bowed his head to President Lee. President Lee greeted Chairman Jung by saying, "You've worked hard." (정 대표는 이날 유럽 순방을 마치고 돌아온 이재명 대통령 환영 행사에 참석해 이 대통령을 향해 고개를 숙였다. 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했습니다”라고 인사를 건넸다.)

At the lawmakers' general meeting, Chairman Jung said, "President Lee Jae-myung has just returned home after a successful European tour," and "President Lee's G7 European tour showcased the essence of national interest-centered, pragmatic diplomacy." He added, "Previous presidents made people anxious whenever they went abroad, but it seems that the public has high expectations for President Lee, wondering what new achievements he will bring back each time he goes on an overseas tour." (정 대표는 의원총회에서 “이재명 대통령께서 성공적인 유럽 순방을 마치고 방금 귀국하셨다”며 “이번 이 대통령의 G7 유럽 순방은 국익 중심, 실용 외교의 정수를 보여줬다”고 했다. 그는 “전임 대통령은 외국에 나갈 때마다 불안불안했었는데, 이 대통령은 외국 순방에 나갈 때마다 어떤 또 성과를 거두고 돌아오실까 국민들도 기대를 많이 하는 것 같다”고 했다.)

Chairman Jung stated, "In particular, securing the maximum tariff-free quota volume for the EU's new steel tariffs, which take effect from the 1st of next month, is a significant achievement that directly benefits our companies and citizens. Upgrading relations with Italy to a special strategic partnership, greatly expanding the scope of cooperation from high-tech industries to culture and tourism, is also an important accomplishment." (정 대표는 “특히 당장 다음 달 1일부터 적용되는 EU의 새로운 철강 관세에 대해 무관세 쿼터 물량을 최대한 확보한 것은 우리 기업과 국민에 직접적으로 도움이 되는 크나큰 성과”라며 “이탈리아와의 특별 전략적 동반자 관계로 격상하여 첨단 산업에서부터 문화 관광에 이르기까지 협력의 폭을 크게 넓힌 것도 중요한 성과”라고 했다.)

Regarding President Lee's conversation with U.S. President Donald Trump, he said, "That was the highlight of the highlights of this tour," describing it as "a moment that reaffirms the special friendship and deep trust between the leaders of South Korea and the U.S., and, as President Trump put it, a historic masterpiece in South Korean diplomatic history that fully displays the image of a strong leader." (또 이 대통령과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 환담을 나눈 것에 대해 “이번 순방의 백미 중의 백미”라며 “한미 정상 간의 각별한 친분과 두터운 신뢰를 거듭 확인하는 자리이자 트럼프 대통령의 표현처럼 강한 지도자로서의 면모를 가감 없이 보여준 대한민국 외교사의 길이 남을 명장면이 아닐까”라고 했다.)

Chairman Jung continued, "I pay tribute and express gratitude for President Lee Jae-myung's unprecedented diplomatic achievements, which fully demonstrated the demeanor of a world-class political leader," and "I sincerely hope that the stalled U.S.-North Korea dialogue will resume, and inter-Korean relations will open new channels, leading to significant progress in the settlement of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (정 대표는 그러면서 “월드 클래스 세계적인 정치 지도자로서의 풍모를 십분 발휘한 이재명 대통령의 역대급 외교 성과에 경의를 표하며 감사드린다”며 “멈춰선 북미 대화가 재개되고 남북 관계도 새로이 물꼬를 터서 한반도 평화 정착과 안정에 큰 진전이 있기를 간절히 소망한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party staff also joined the National Election Commission's controversial "junket-style" overseas trips (선관위 ‘외유성’ 해외출장에 민주당 직원도 동행)
item.description:
Democratic Party staff also joined the National Election Commission's controversial "junket-style" overseas trips (선관위 ‘외유성’ 해외출장에 민주당 직원도 동행)

Amid controversy over the National Election Commission's overseas trips being criticized as junkets, it has been revealed that staff from the Democratic Party of Korea also accompanied some of these trips. <<> According to data on "overseas trips by National Election Commission staff over the past five years" submitted to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun on the 18th, two Democratic Party staff accompanied the commission's overseas trips in 2023. The stated reason was to check the overseas voting management system in preparation for the 22nd National Assembly election. <<> The data shows that one Democratic Party staff member joined the commission's trip to Osaka, Japan, for two nights and three days in August 2023. The expenses for three commission staff and one Democratic Party staff member amounted to approximately 7.3 million won. Around the same period, another Democratic Party staff member accompanied a trip to Siem Reap, Cambodia, for four nights and five days. The budget for four commission staff and one Democratic Party staff member's trip expenses was set at 15.4 million won. <<> Lawmaker Kim's office stated that both trips were conducted without even a review, as they were classified as official overseas trips for specific business purposes under relevant regulations. <<> Kim said, "It's equally problematic whether it's the Democratic Party, which blindly followed along on overseas trips funded by taxpayers' money, or the commission, which only brought along staff from a specific political party under the guise of system inspections." He added, "A full investigation should be conducted not only into the flawed elections but also into these 'flawed trips' that wasted taxpayers' money." <<> Earlier, on the 16th, the People Power Party's Media Special Committee and Media Legal Team announced they would file charges of embezzlement against National Election Commission officials suspected of taking junket-style trips to resorts like the Maldives. <<> At the time, the People Power Party's Media Special Committee cited media reports, pointing out, "Commission officials stayed four nights in Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia, where the number of voters was only about 120, and while the official task of checking overseas voting was completed in just half a day, the remaining schedule was left blank without even an itinerary," labeling it a junket trip. (중앙선거관리위원회의 해외 출장이 외유성 논란에 휩싸인 가운데 일부 출장에 더불어민주당 직원도 동행했다는 사실이 드러났다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Kim Yo-jong on G7 ‘Denuclearization’ Statement: “Nuclear Possession is Our Core Interest… Denuclearization Won’t Happen” ([속보] 北김여정, G7 ‘비핵화’ 성명에 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익…비핵화 안 될 것”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Kim Yo-jong on G7 ‘Denuclearization’ Statement: “Nuclear Possession is Our Core Interest… Denuclearization Won’t Happen” ([속보] 北김여정, G7 ‘비핵화’ 성명에 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익…비핵화 안 될 것”)

Kim Yo-jong, a department director of North Korea’s Workers’ Party, stated in response to the G7 leaders’ joint statement expressing concerns over North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs that “our nuclear weapons are permanent and unchangeable,” adding that “the G7 has no qualifications or rights to discuss our sovereign choices.” (김여정 북한 노동당 부장이 북핵·미사일에 대한 우려를 나타낸 G7(7국) 정상 공동성명에 대해 “우리 핵은 영구불변”이라며 “(G7은) 주권적 선택을 논할 자격이나 권리가 없다”고 밝혔다.)

In a statement released through the Korean Central News Agency on the 18th, Kim Yo-jong declared that “nuclear possession is our core interest” and “denuclearization won’t happen.” (김여정은 18일 조선중앙통신을 통해 내놓은 담화에서 “핵 보유는 우리 핵심 이익”이며 “비핵화는 안 될 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Earlier, the G7 leaders had adopted a joint statement saying, “We express deep concern over North Korea’s nuclear and ballistic missile programs and reaffirm our commitment to achieving the complete denuclearization of North Korea in accordance with UN Security Council resolutions.” (앞서 G7 정상들은 “우리는 북한의 핵 및 탄도미사일 프로그램에 대해 깊은 우려를 표명하며 유엔 안전보장이사회 결의에 따라 북한의 완전한 비핵화를 실현하겠다는 우리 의지를 재확인한다”는 공동성명을 채택했다.)

item.title: S. Korea Skips G7 Declaration on Critical Mineral Supply Chains... Strategic Distance Amid China-Containment Sentiment (韓 G7 ‘핵심광물 공급망’ 선언 불참… 中 견제 기류 속 ‘전략적 거리두기’)
item.description:
S. Korea Skips G7 Declaration on Critical Mineral Supply Chains... Strategic Distance Amid China-Containment Sentiment (韓 G7 ‘핵심광물 공급망’ 선언 불참… 中 견제 기류 속 ‘전략적 거리두기’)

President Lee Jae-myung did not sign the "Stabilizing Critical Mineral Supply Chains" declaration adopted at the G7 summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France. Among the eight documents adopted at the G7 summit, he declined to sign the declaration on stabilizing critical mineral supply chains, while signing the remaining seven. Although the document does not explicitly mention China, it is widely seen as targeting China, which has effectively imposed export controls on rare earths. While G7 member states and Australia signed the document, South Korea, Brazil, India, Egypt, and Kenya did not. (이재명 대통령이 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7 정상회의에서 채택된 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언문에 서명하지 않았다. G7 정상회의에서 채택된 문건 8건 가운데 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언문에 대해서는 서명에 불참한 것이다. 나머지 7건에는 서명했다. 해당 문건에는 중국이라는 표현은 없지만 사실상 희토류 수출 통제에 나선 중국을 겨냥한 것으로 평가된다. G7 회원국들과 호주가 해당 문건에 서명한 반면 한국과 브라질, 인도, 이집트, 케냐는 서명하지 않았다.)

The presidential office stated, "Although we did not participate in the declaration, we support the G7's efforts to diversify critical minerals and build resilient supply chains." The presidential office maintains that South Korea's situation differs from other countries, as it has already developed many alternative supply routes. However, some analysts suggest that the decision not to sign may have been influenced by concerns about China. (청와대는 “선언문에는 불참했으나 G7의 핵심 광물 다변화와 회복력 있는 공급망 구축 노력은 지지한다”고 밝혔다. 청와대 측은 한국의 경우 대체 공급선을 많이 개발해 다른 국가들과 상황이 다르다는 입장이지만 중국을 의식해 서명에 불참한 것 아니냐는 해석도 제기된다.)

This G7 declaration on "Stabilizing Critical Mineral Supply Chains" aims to reduce excessive dependence on specific countries in the production and processing of critical minerals, and to strengthen supply chain diversification and transparency. Diplomatic circles view this declaration as a starting signal for "building a China-free supply chain" targeting China. (이번 G7의 ‘핵심 광물 공급망 안정화’ 선언은 핵심 광물의 생산과 가공 분야에서 특정 국가에 대한 과도한 의존도를 낮추고, 공급망의 다변화 및 투명성을 강화하겠다는 내용을 담고 있다. 외교가에서는 이번 선언이 중국을 겨냥한 ‘탈중국 공급망 구축’의 신호탄이라고 보고 있다.)

South Korea currently relies heavily on Chinese minerals and materials in key industries such as secondary batteries and semiconductors. If the country had fully joined this declaration, it would have inevitably faced severe backlash from China, including trade retaliation measures, which likely factored into the decision. While the presidential office took a cautious stance, stating that it "supports the G7's efforts to diversify critical minerals and build resilient supply chains," it is widely assessed as a realistic diplomatic strategy that takes into account relations with China. (우리나라는 이차전지, 반도체 등 핵심 산업에서 중국산 광물 및 소재에 대한 의존도가 매우 높은 상황이다. 만약 이번 선언에 전면 동참할 경우 중국의 거센 반발과 무역 보복 조치 등 경제적 타격이 불가피하다는 판단이 작용했을 것으로 보인다. 청와대는 이번 불참에 대해 “핵심 광물 다변화와 회복력 있는 공급망 구축이라는 G7의 노력은 지지한다”며 신중한 입장을 보였으나, 사실상 대중국 관계를 고려한 현실적인 외교 전략이라는 평가가 지배적이다.)

item.title: "Humanistic Leadership Needed to Uphold Human Dignity" (“인간의 존엄 지키는 인본주의적 리더십 필요”)
item.description:
"Humanistic Leadership Needed to Uphold Human Dignity" (“인간의 존엄 지키는 인본주의적 리더십 필요”)

"Dosan spread the spirit of 'aegiaeta' (loving oneself as loving others) for national unity among our divided compatriots about 100 years ago. Aegiaeta is the spiritual foundation necessary for Korean society today." (Kang Seok-jin, Chairman of the Convergence Coexistence Forum) (“도산은 약 100년 전 분열된 우리 동포들에게 국민 화합을 위한 애기애타(愛己愛他) 정신을 전파했습니다. 애기애타는 지금 한국 사회에 필요한 정신적 근간입니다.” (강석진 융합상생포럼 이사장))

Senior figures from academia and industry in South Korea held a symposium on the 17th at the National Assembly Library in Yeouido, Seoul, under the theme of 'Aegiaeta Leadership in the Age of AI (Artificial Intelligence).' Aegiaeta is a leadership spirit emphasized by Dosan Ahn Chang-ho, meaning 'Love others as you love yourself.' The event was organized by the Convergence Coexistence Forum, a nonprofit organization, and Representative Kang Seung-gyu of the People Power Party. Founded in 2016, the Convergence Coexistence Forum has held regular meetings on topics such as social integration, the Fourth Industrial Revolution, and technological advancement. (국내 학계·산업계 원로들이 17일 ‘AI(인공지능) 시대의 애기애타 리더십’ 을 주제로 서울 여의도 국회도서관에서 심포지엄을 열었다. 애기애타는 도산 안창호 선생이 강조한 리더십 정신으로 ‘나를 사랑하듯 남을 사랑하라’는 뜻이다. 이번 행사는 사단법인 융합상생포럼과 국민의힘 강승규 의원이 개최했다. 2016년 창립한 융합상생포럼은 사회 대통합, 4차 산업혁명, 기술 선진화 등을 주제로 정기 회의를 열어왔다.)

Chairman Kang Seok-jin stated, "Although South Korea is an economically advanced country, its political culture, which ranks among the lowest in the world, is seriously dividing the people. Politicians should take the lead in advancing political culture with the spirit of aegiaeta." Seo Sang-mok, a former Minister of Health and Welfare and distinguished professor at Kangnam University, mentioned situations of political leadership absence, such as two presidential impeachments, the US-China hegemony competition, and Europe's division, noting, "Policies or systems alone cannot resolve these situations." Professor Seo explained the significance of the aegiaeta spirit, saying, "We need humanistic leadership that contemplates how to preserve human dignity." (강석진 이사장은 “한국은 경제 선진국이지만, 세계 하위권인 정치 문화가 국민을 심각하게 분열시키고 있다”며 “정치인들이 애기애타 정신으로 정치 문화를 선진화시키는 데 앞장 서달라”고 했다. 보건복지부 장관을 지낸 서상목 강남대 석좌교수는 두차례 대통령 탄핵, 미·중 패권 경쟁, 유럽의 분열 등 정치적 리더십 부재 상황을 언급하면서 “정책이나 제도만으론 이런 상황을 해결하기 어렵다”고 했다. 서 석좌교수는 “인간의 존엄을 어떻게 지킬 것인가를 숙고하는 인본주의적 리더십이 필요하다”며 애기애타 정신의 의의를 설명했다.)

Kim Moon-soo, former Governor of Gyeonggi Province, said, "Following Dosan's teachings, we must always reflect on ourselves and build leadership that loves others as much as we love ourselves." Kim Jeon-seung, Chairman of the Heungsadan Association, emphasized aegiaeta leadership, stating, "Depending on how we respond to AI development, society can either advance or regress. Technology should not be the center; people should be." Son Wook, Chairman of the Sejong National Governance Research Institute, linked the aegiaeta spirit to King Sejong's democracy, which holds that 'the people are the foundation of the nation,' and added, "We must maximize human dignity to change South Korea, which is mired in division and conflict." (김문수 전 경기지사는 “도산의 가르침대로 자기 자신을 항상 돌아보고 그만큼 남을 사랑하는 리더십을 세워야 한다”고 했다. 김전승 흥사단 이사장은 “AI 발전에 어떻게 대응하느냐에 따라 사회가 발전할 수도, 퇴보할 수도 있다. 기술이 아닌 사람이 중심이 돼야 한다”면서 애기애타 리더십을 강조했다. 손욱 세종국가경영연구원 이사장은 애기애타 정신이 ‘백성이 나라의 근본’이라는 세종의 민본주의와 연결돼 있다면서 “인간의 존엄을 극대화해 분열과 갈등에 빠진 대한민국을 바꿔야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Building an AI Cluster in Hanam to Become a City Jensen Huang Will Visit" (“하남에 AI 클러스터 꾸려 젠슨 황이 찾는 도시 될 것”)
item.description:
"Building an AI Cluster in Hanam to Become a City Jensen Huang Will Visit" (“하남에 AI 클러스터 꾸려 젠슨 황이 찾는 도시 될 것”)

The June 3 Hanam mayoral election was one of the most fiercely contested races for basic local government heads in Gyeonggi Province. Incumbent Mayor Lee Hyun-jae (77) of the People Power Party won with 51.95% of the vote, defeating Democratic Party candidate Kang Byeong-deok (48.04%) by a margin of 3.91 percentage points. This marks the first time a mayor from a People Power Party-affiliated party has been re-elected in Hanam. Mayor Lee, who previously served as the head of the Small and Medium Business Administration and as a member of the 19th and 20th National Assemblies, was first elected mayor of Hanam in 2022. (6·3 하남시장 선거는 경기도 기초단체장 선거 중 가장 치열한 승부가 벌어진 곳 중 하나다. 국민의힘 이현재(77) 시장이 득표율 51.95%로 더불어민주당 강병덕(48.04%) 후보를 3.91%포인트 차로 꺾었다. 하남에서 국민의힘 계열 정당 소속 시장이 재선에 성공한 것은 처음이다. 이 시장은 중소기업청장과 19·20대 국회의원 등을 거쳐 2022년 하남시장에 당선됐다.)

On the 17th, I met Mayor Lee in his office at Hanam City Hall. His black suit paired with white sneakers caught my eye. This has become his trademark, which sparked conversation during the election. The left lace was blue, and the right lace was red. (지난 17일 하남시청 시장실에서 이 시장을 만났다. 검은색 정장에 흰색 운동화가 눈길을 끌었다. 선거 때 화제를 모은 그의 ‘트레이드마크’였다. 왼쪽은 파란색 끈, 오른쪽은 빨간색 끈을 묶었다.)

- How did you come to wear them? (-어떻게 신게 됐나.)

"Since I was first elected mayor of Hanam in 2022, I've consistently worn red sneakers, symbolizing the People Power Party. But some citizens asked if I was emphasizing my political color too much. So this time, I started tying both red and blue shoelaces together. It means that citizens' happiness comes before ideology or political factions. At first, it felt a bit awkward, but the citizens' response was better than I expected, so I keep wearing them." (“2022년 처음 하남시장에 당선된 이후 줄곧 국민의힘을 상징하는 빨간색 운동화를 신었다. 그런데 정치 색깔을 너무 강조하는 것 아니냐는 시민들이 있었다. 그래서 이번엔 빨간색과 파란색 신발끈을 함께 매기 시작했다. 이념이나 정파보다 시민 행복이 우선이라는 뜻이다. 처음에는 좀 어색했지만 시민들 반응이 생각보다 좋아 계속 신고 있다.”)

- What do you think contributed to your re-election? (-재선에 성공한 요인이 무엇이라고 생각하나.)

"I believe the citizens of Hanam carefully considered who would best lead Hanam's development, rather than focusing on factional logic or party colors. There were many instances of cross-voting. Many citizens voted for the Democratic Party's candidate Choo Mi-ae in the Gyeonggi Province governor election while casting their votes for me in the Hanam mayoral election." (“하남 시민들이 진영 논리나 정당의 색깔보다 누가 하남 발전을 잘 이끌지 꼼꼼하게 따져보셨다고 생각한다. 교차 투표 사례도 많았다. 경기도지사 선거는 민주당 추미애 후보를 찍으면서 하남시장 선거는 나에게 표를 준 시민이 많았다.”)

- How was the election process? (-선거 과정은 어땠나.)

"The hardest part was the low approval rating of the People Power Party. When I met citizens, I often heard, 'Lee Hyun-jae does a good job, but I'm conflicted because of the party.' The only option was to meet more citizens. I visited every alley and restaurant. I personally explained what I had accomplished over the past four years and how I plan to change Hanam going forward. When I put in the effort, even initially indifferent citizens started to listen." (“가장 힘들었던 것은 낮은 국민의힘 지지율이었다. 시민들을 만나면 ‘이현재는 일 잘하는데 당 때문에 고민된다’는 이야기를 정말 많이 들었다. 시민들을 더 많이 만나는 수밖에 없었다. 골목골목 식당을 다 다녔다. 지난 4년 동안 무엇을 했는지, 앞으로 하남을 어떻게 바꿀지 직접 설명했다. 정성을 다하니 시큰둥하던 시민들도 귀를 기울여주시더라.”)

- At 77, you are the oldest among the basic local government heads elected in this local election. (-올해 77세로 이번 지방선거에서 당선된 기초단체장 중 최고령이다.)

"I work hard at maintaining my fitness. I do push-ups and dumbbell exercises at home, and I also ride a stationary bike. Recently, I've been walking around City Hall for about 20 to 30 minutes a day. The secret to my stamina is thinking positively. I try not to hold on to stress for long." (“평소 체력 관리를 열심히 한다. 집에서 팔굽혀펴기와 아령 운동을 하고 실내 자전거도 탄다. 최근에는 하루 20~30분 정도 시청 주변을 걷고 있다. 체력의 비결은 긍정적으로 생각하는 것이다. 스트레스를 오래 안고 가지 않으려고 노력한다.”)

- What areas will you focus on over the next four years? (-앞으로 4년간 집중 투자할 분야는.)

"The economy. Hanam is a great city to live in, but its economic strength is weak. Ultimately, we must attract businesses and create jobs. I am staking everything on developing the Gyo-san New Town AI Innovation Cluster. It's a 3 trillion won project involving POSTECH, Carnegie Mellon University, the National University of Singapore, and KT Cloud. The goal is to transform Hanam into an AI industrial city that global business leaders like NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang or OpenAI CEO Sam Altman will visit. In Misa-dong, we plan to build 'K-Star World,' a complex combining performance, entertainment, and MICE (exhibitions) as a K-culture complex." (“경제다. 하남은 살기 좋은 도시지만 경제력이 약하다. 결국 기업을 유치하고 일자리를 만들어야 한다. 교산신도시 AI(인공지능) 혁신 클러스터 조성에 사활을 걸고 있다. 포스텍과 카네기멜론대, 싱가포르국립대, KT클라우드 등이 참여하는 3조원 규모 사업이다. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)나 샘 올트먼 오픈AI CEO 같은 글로벌 기업인들이 찾는 AI 산업 도시를 만드는 것이 목표다. 미사동에는 공연·엔터테인먼트·마이스(전시) 복합단지인 ‘K-스타월드(K컬처 복합 콤플렉스)’를 만들 계획이다.”)

- How will K-Star World be promoted? (-K-스타월드는 어떻게 추진하나.)

"K-Star World is not just about building a single performance venue. It's about creating a cultural industry ecosystem that blends K-pop concert halls, film studios, and K-culture companies. Around K-Star World, on the Han River riverside, we plan to develop a national garden to create synergy." (“K-스타월드는 단순히 공연장 하나를 짓는 사업이 아니다. K팝 공연장과 영화 촬영 스튜디오, K컬처 기업 등이 버무려진 문화 산업 생태계를 만드는 사업이다. K-스타월드 주변 한강 둔치에는 국가정원을 조성해 시너지를 낼 생각이다.”)

item.title: Special Counsel Law Hangs in the Balance… Ruling and Opposition Clash Over Judiciary Committee Chairmanship (특검법 걸려있다… 여야, 법사위원장 자리 놓고 충돌)
item.description:
Special Counsel Law Hangs in the Balance… Ruling and Opposition Clash Over Judiciary Committee Chairmanship (특검법 걸려있다… 여야, 법사위원장 자리 놓고 충돌)

Twenty days have passed since the start of the second half of the National Assembly session, but the ruling and opposition parties remain deadlocked in negotiations over the formation of the parliamentary body. The key point of contention is which side will take the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. (후반기 국회가 시작된 지 20일이 지났지만 여야(與野)는 원(院) 구성 협상에서 대치를 이어가고 있다. 쟁점은 국회 법제사법위원장을 어느 쪽이 맡느냐는 것이다.)

The Judiciary Committee serves as the "final gateway" for various bills. Among the pending contentious bills is the "Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Act," proposed by the Democratic Party. This bill unusually grants the special counsel the authority to revoke indictments, leading the opposition to argue that it aims to withdraw indictments in criminal cases involving President Lee Jae-myung through the special counsel. (법사위는 각종 법안의 ‘최종 관문’ 역할을 하는데, 현재 대기 중인 대표적 쟁점 법안으로 민주당이 발의한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’이 있다. 이 법안은 조작 기소 특검에게 이례적으로 공소 취소 권한을 부여했고, 이 때문에 특검을 통해 이재명 대통령 형사사건의 공소를 취소하려 한다고 야권이 반발해 왔다.)

The People Power Party maintains that "to prevent the Democratic Party from forcing through the special counsel act, we cannot give up the Judiciary Committee chairmanship." The Democratic Party also insists it cannot concede the Judiciary Committee chairmanship. Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do stated at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 18th, "If we give up the Judiciary Committee, we will become an incompetent ruling party unable to get things done," adding, "We will approach negotiations with the unwavering principle that the Democratic Party will firmly secure the Judiciary Committee." In a closed-door meeting, Han further remarked, "The opposition is blocking livelihood bills through filibusters, and if we lose the Judiciary Committee chairmanship, the current government's hands will be completely tied." (국민의힘은 “민주당의 특검법 강행을 막기 위해서라도 법사위원장은 내줄 수 없다”는 입장이다. 민주당도 법사위원장은 양보할 수 없다고 했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 18일 의원총회에서 “법사위를 양보하면 일을 못하는 무능한 여당이 될 것”이라며 “법사위는 민주당이 확실하게 가져온다는 원칙을 갖고 흔들림 없이 협상에 임하도록 하겠다”고 했다. 이어 한 원내대표는 비공개 회의에서도 “민생법안도 야당이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 막고 있는데 법사위원장까지 뺏기면 현 정부 발목 다 묶이는 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to finalize the parliamentary formation by next week. Democratic Party floor spokesperson Lee Joo-hee said, "After completing the parliamentary formation next week, a workshop for all Democratic Party lawmakers is scheduled for the 3rd of next month," adding, "We will discuss the operation of the second half of the National Assembly and activities after the formation in detail." (민주당은 다음 주까지 원 구성을 마무리하겠다는 계획이다. 이주희 민주당 원내대변인은 “다음 주 원 구성을 마무리한 이후 다음 달 3일 민주당 전체 의원 워크숍이 개최될 예정”이라며 “하반기 국회 운영과 원 구성 이후 활동에 대해 구체적으로 논의할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Observations in political circles suggest that "the Democratic Party will unilaterally push for the election of standing committee chairs." Since standing committee chairs are elected in the plenary session, not within each committee, the Democratic Party, holding a majority of seats, could dominate all 18 standing committee chairs through a single vote. In fact, in 2020, when negotiations with the then-ruling Democratic Party and the Future United Party (now the People Power Party) broke down, the Democratic Party unilaterally elected 18 standing committee chairs in the plenary session and operated them for a year. This was the first such occurrence since democratization in 1987. (정치권에서는 “민주당이 상임위원장 선출을 단독으로 밀어붙일 것”이란 관측이 나온다. 국회 상임위원장은 각 상임위원회가 아닌 본회의에서 선출되기 때문에 다수 의석을 확보한 민주당이 단독 표결을 통해 18개 상임위원장을 독차지하는 것도 가능하다. 실제 2020년 당시 여당인 민주당은 미래통합당(현 국민의힘)과의 원 구성 협상이 결렬되자 국회 본회의에서 18개 상임위원장직을 단독 선출해 1년간 운영했다. 1987년 민주화 이후 처음이었다.)

People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik stated at a Supreme Council meeting, "Refusing to give up the Judiciary Committee chairmanship means refusing to abandon the forced passage of the indictment revocation special counsel act," and warned, "If the Judiciary Committee does not return to its proper place, the normalization of the National Assembly in the second half will be difficult, and the legislative dominance of the Lee Jae-myung government through the Judiciary Committee will continue." He added, "Restoring the Judiciary Committee is the top premise for parliamentary formation negotiations." This was interpreted to mean that if the People Power Party is not given the Judiciary Committee chairmanship, negotiations on the parliamentary formation will not be concluded. (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 “법사위원장직을 포기하지 않겠다는 건 공소취소 특검법 강행 처리를 포기하지 않겠다는 뜻”이라며 “법사위가 제자리로 돌아오지 않는다면 후반기 국회 정상화는 난망하고, 법사위를 앞세운 이재명 정부의 입법 독주도 계속될 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “법사위 제자리가 원 구성 협상의 대전제”라고 했다. 국민의힘에게 법사위원장을 주지 않는다면 원 구성 협상이 타결되지 않을 것이란 의미로 해석됐다.)

The People Power Party decided to expand and reorganize the "Special Committee to Block President Lee Jae-myung's Trial Revocation" into a party special committee. Originally established under the Central Election Countermeasure Committee for the June 3 local elections and operated temporarily during the election period, it has been converted into a party special committee to respond more proactively to the issue of indictment revocation. Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo, a former prosecutor, will chair the committee, with its first meeting scheduled for the 22nd. (국민의힘은 이날 ‘이재명 대통령 재판취소 저지 특별위원회’를 당 특별위원회로 확대 개편하기로 했다. 해당 특위는 당초 6·3 지방선거 중앙선거대책위원회 산하에 설치돼 선거 기간 한시 운영됐으나, 공소취소 문제에 보다 적극적으로 대응하기 위해 당 특위로 전환됐다. 위원장은 검찰 출신인 주진우 의원이 맡았고 오는 22일 첫 회의를 열 예정이다.)

Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae stated in March, "In forming the second-half parliamentary body, the principle is that the Democratic Party will take 100% responsibility for the standing committee chairs." However, the Democratic Party suffered a defeat in Seoul during the June 3 local elections, and considering the recent decline in approval ratings, the political burden of "monopolizing standing committees" is not insignificant. (정청래 민주당 대표는 지난 3월 “후반기 원 구성에 있어서 상임위원장은 100% 민주당이 맡아서 책임을 지겠다는 원칙”이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당은 6·3 지방선거에서 서울에서 패배했고, 최근 지지율 하락을 감안하면 ‘상임위 독식’에 따른 정치적 부담도 적지 않은 상황이다.)

National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, formerly of the Democratic Party, urged the ruling and opposition parties to reach an agreement on parliamentary formation in his opening remarks at the plenary session. Cho stated, "To fully restart the clock on all livelihood legislation, the formation of the second-half parliamentary body must be completed quickly," noting, "There are currently around 140 bills awaiting review by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee after passing standing committees, and many bills are awaiting review within the standing committees." In May, shortly after being confirmed as a candidate for the National Assembly Speaker, Cho said, "We will swiftly complete the parliamentary formation by June and handle all legislative tasks for state affairs by December." (민주당 출신인 조정식 국회의장은 이날 본회의 모두발언에서 여야에 원 구성 합의를 촉구했다. 조 의장은 “모든 민생 입법 시계를 온전히 가동하기 위해서는 후반기 원 구성을 서둘러 마무리해야 한다”며 “현재 상임위원회를 통과해 법제사법위원회 심사를 기다리는 법안이 140여 건이고, 상임위에서 법안 심사를 기다리는 법안도 많다”고 했다. 조 의장은 지난 5월 국회의장 후보로 확정된 직후 “6월 내에 원 구성을 신속히 완료하고, 12월 내 국정 과제 입법을 모두 처리하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Han Sung-sook’s Confirmation Hearing: Zero Witnesses and Reference Persons—Blocked by Democratic Party Opposition (한성숙 총리 인사청문회, 증인도 참고인도 0명… 민주당 반대로 못 불러)
item.description:
Prime Minister Han Sung-sook’s Confirmation Hearing: Zero Witnesses and Reference Persons—Blocked by Democratic Party Opposition (한성숙 총리 인사청문회, 증인도 참고인도 0명… 민주당 반대로 못 불러)

The National Assembly confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook, scheduled for the 25th and 26th, is expected to proceed without any witnesses or reference persons. The People Power Party applied for 11 witnesses and reference persons, but the Democratic Party opposed it. This marks the second time a prime minister confirmation hearing has been held without witnesses or reference persons, following that of former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok last year. The People Power Party criticizes that “the ruling Democratic Party is even blocking the opportunity to verify the qualifications and capabilities of the prime minister nominee.” Han, a former CEO of Naver, served as Minister of SMEs and Startups in President Lee Jae-myung’s first cabinet before being nominated as prime minister on the 7th. <<> The National Assembly Personnel Confirmation Special Committee held a meeting on the 18th and approved a hearing plan without witnesses or reference persons. The People Power Party had requested to verify allegations that Han leased his own building in Yeongeon-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, to his younger brother at a below-market price, as well as suspicions that Naver sponsored 3.9 billion won in advertising fees to Seongnam FC, whose owner was then-Seongnam Mayor Lee Jae-myung, during Lee’s tenure. To investigate, they applied for 11 witnesses and reference persons, including Han’s younger brother, Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin, and former Naver CEO Kim Sang-heon. However, the Democratic Party opposed it, calling it “a fishing expedition to tarnish the administration.” <<> Rep. Kang Seung-kyu, the People Power Party secretary on the committee, stated, “The essence of a confirmation hearing is to examine allegations related to the nominee through witnesses and reference persons. It is very regrettable that the ruling party rejected the adoption of witnesses.” Rep. Kim Han-kyu, the Democratic Party secretary, countered, “The People Power Party’s demand for witnesses seems aimed at turning this hearing into a fishing expedition and a forum for tarnishing the Lee Jae-myung administration, and we cannot accept it. These are issues that were sufficiently addressed during the hearing for the Minister of SMEs and Startups last July.” <<> When the ruling party argued that “calling family members is excessive,” the People Power Party side responded, “That’s because annual gift tax payment records have not been submitted.” Rep. Kim Hee-jung of the People Power Party noted, “During last year’s hearing for Han as Minister of SMEs and Startups, there were a total of 1,966 requests for materials, but only 37% were submitted. They refused citing personal information or trade secrets, and promised to provide explanations after becoming minister, but no additional materials have been submitted to this day.” The chair of the Personnel Confirmation Special Committee for nominee Han is Rep. Baek Hye-ryun of the Democratic Party. (오는 25~26일 열릴 한성숙 국무총리 후보자의 국회 인사청문회가 증인과 참고인 없이 진행될 전망이다. 국민의힘이 11명을 증인과 참고인으로 신청했지만 더불어민주당이 반대했기 때문이다. 국무총리 인사청문회가 증인·참고인 없이 열리는 것은 지난해 김민석 국무총리 인사청문회 이후 이번이 두번째다. 국민의힘에선 “다수당인 민주당이 총리 후보자의 자질과 능력을 검증할 기회마저 차단한다”는 비판이 나온다. 네이버 대표이사 출신인 한 후보자는 이재명 정부 1기 내각에서 중소벤처기업부 장관으로 일하다 지난 7일 총리 후보자로 지명됐다.)

item.title: People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting (‘사전투표 폐지’ 국힘 법안 발의)
item.description:
People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting (‘사전투표 폐지’ 국힘 법안 발의)

Rep. Park Dae-chul of the People Power Party (PPP) proposed a bill on the 18th to abolish the early voting system and expand the regular voting period to two days. This is the first time a bill to abolish early voting has been introduced following the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections. The bill also includes the reintroduction of an "absentee voting system," allowing voters who have difficulty visiting polling stations during the regular voting period to vote for two days starting four days before the election after prior registration. (국민의힘 박대출 의원이 18일 사전투표 제도를 폐지하고 본투표 기간을 이틀로 확대하는 내용의 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 이후 사전투표 폐지 법안이 발의된 것은 이번이 처음이다. 본투표 기간에 투표소 방문이 어려운 유권자는 사전 신고를 거쳐 선거 4일 전부터 이틀간 투표할 수 있도록 하는 ‘부재자투표제’를 재도입하는 내용도 포함됐다.)

The bill is co-sponsored by 25 lawmakers, including 24 from the PPP—such as Song Eon-seok, Yoo Sang-beom, Kim Seong-won, Kwon Young-jin, and Shin Dong-wook—and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon. Regarding the rationale for the bill, Rep. Park Dae-chul stated, "Early voting was introduced to enhance voter accessibility, but it has excessively prioritized convenience, repeatedly undermining the essence of elections, which is fairness and credibility. The aim is to block any room for negligence or fraud in the election process and restore election fairness and public trust." The early voting system was initially agreed upon by the ruling and opposition parties in 2012 to expand political participation rights, piloted, and formally introduced from the 2014 local elections. However, calls for its abolition have persisted among some quarters due to issues with early voting management. The Democratic Party, however, maintains that calls to abolish early voting are "regressive for democratic history." <<> Meanwhile, the ruling and opposition parties held a plenary session of the National Assembly on the same day and passed a plan for a parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage incident. This initiates a 45-day parliamentary probe targeting the National Election Commission (NEC) and local election commissions at all levels. It marks the first time in constitutional history that a parliamentary investigation has been conducted into the NEC, a constitutional institution. The special committee for the investigation consists of 18 lawmakers: 9 from the Democratic Party, 7 from the PPP, 1 from the Fatherland Innovation Party, and 1 from the Reform Party, with the PPP taking the chairmanship. The PPP argues that since the parliamentary investigation lacks compulsory investigative powers, a special counsel should be pursued in parallel. (이 법안에는 송언석·유상범·김성원·권영진·신동욱 등 국민의힘 의원 24명과 무소속 한동훈 의원 등 총 25명이 이름을 올렸다. 박대출 의원은 법안 발의 이유에 대해 “사전투표는 유권자의 투표 접근성을 높이기 위해 도입됐지만 편의성에만 치우친 나머지 선거의 본질인 공정성과 신뢰성이 반복적으로 훼손되고 있다”며 “선거 과정에서 부실·부정이 개입할 여지를 차단하고, 선거 공정성과 국민 신뢰를 회복하려는 것”이라고 했다. 사전투표제는 참정권 확대 차원에서 여야가 2012년 합의해 시범 실시를 거쳐 2014년 지방선거부터 정식 도입됐다. 하지만 이후 사전투표 관리 문제 등을 이유로 일각에선 꾸준히 폐지론이 제기돼왔다. 다만 민주당은 사전투표 폐지론에 대해 “민주주의 역사를 역행하는 주장”이라는 입장이다.)

Separately, the NEC announced that 271 election appeal petitions had been filed by the midnight deadline of June 17, the closing date for filing appeals for the June 3 local elections. This represents an approximately 20-fold increase compared to the 13 petitions in the 2022 local elections. By election type, the appeals included 126 for metropolitan mayors and governors (including 28 for the Seoul mayor), 67 for superintendents of education, 59 for proportional council members at the metropolitan level, 5 for Sejong city council members, and 14 unspecified cases. Election appeals are a system allowing challenges to election results with the NEC, which must render a decision within 60 days. Legal circles generally assess that the low likelihood of the NEC accepting the appeals means they are likely to lead to lawsuits. (이런 가운데 여야는 이날 국회 본회의를 열고 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사할 국회 국정조사 계획서를 통과시켰다. 이에 따라 중앙선관위 및 각급 지역 선관위를 대상으로 한 45일간의 국정조사가 시작됐다. 헌법기관인 선관위를 대상으로 한 국정조사는 헌정사상 처음이다. 국정조사 특별위원회는 민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 조국혁신당 1명, 개혁신당 1명 등 의원 18명으로 구성됐고, 위원장은 국민의힘이 맡는다. 국민의힘은 국정조사는 강제수사권이 없는만큼 특검을 병행하자는 입장이다.)

item.title: President May Expand Personnel Reshuffle as Approval Rating Reversal Card (지지율 반전 카드로 靑 인사폭 키울 수도)
item.description:
President May Expand Personnel Reshuffle as Approval Rating Reversal Card (지지율 반전 카드로 靑 인사폭 키울 수도)

As approval ratings for both the president and the party have fallen in tandem since the June 3 local elections, observations are emerging that the previously anticipated minor reshuffle of presidential office aides may expand. This comes amid growing voices that the only reversal card is a personnel overhaul. President Lee Jae-myung is scheduled to directly explain the outcomes of his 8-night, 10-day European tour, including attending the G7 summit, at 2 PM on the 19th, drawing attention to whether he will address party-presidential office conflicts over responsibility for the local elections and the decline in approval ratings. (6·3 지방선거 이후 대통령과 당 지지율이 동반 하락하면서, 당초 소폭으로 예상됐던 청와대 참모진 인사가 커질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 반전 카드는 인사 쇄신밖에 없다는 목소리가 커지면서다. 이재명 대통령이 19일 오후 2시 G7(7국) 정상회의 참석 등 8박 10일간의 유럽 순방 성과를 직접 설명할 예정인 가운데, 지방선거 책임론 등을 둘러싼 당청 갈등 및 지지율 하락 등에 대한 입장을 밝힐지 주목된다.)

As President Lee Jae-myung marked his first year in office on the 4th, discussions about replacing his aides emerged within and outside the presidential office. Regarding the scale of the reshuffle, given the president's strong trust in the Chief of Staff, National Security Office Director, and Policy Office Director, a minor reshuffle was expected, such as only replacing some senior secretaries or filling vacant positions. There were also predictions that the president would pursue an inclusive reshuffle by recruiting some opposition figures, in line with his often-stated goal of being "the president of all people." (이재명 대통령이 지난 4일 취임 1년을 맞으면서 청와대 안팎에선 참모진 교체 얘기가 나왔다. 인사 규모에 대해선 비서실장, 국가안보실장, 정책실장에 대한 대통령 신임이 큰 만큼 ‘3실장’은 그대로 두고, 일부 수석급만 바꾸거나 빈자리를 채우는 정도의 소폭 인사가 예상됐다. 여기에 이 대통령이 평소 말해온 ‘모든 국민의 대통령’ 취지에 맞게 야권 인사를 일부 발탁하는 통합 인사에 나설 것이라는 예측도 있었다.)

However, the situation is said to have completely changed after losing key strongholds like the Seoul mayoral seat, a barometer of public sentiment, in the local elections. A ruling party source said, "We won in the number of metropolitan and provincial governors but lost in quality. To drastically change the current atmosphere, where even 'blame games' are occurring, there's no alternative but a personnel innovation. I understand that opinions are being strongly conveyed to the president that, even if it doesn't go as far as replacing the presidential office directors, a mid-scale cabinet reshuffle is needed, such as a major replacement of senior secretaries and deputy secretaries, or changing several ministers." Another insider added, "The president said he 'absolutely cannot accept' the local election results and immediately told Representative Jeong Cheong-rae not to attend the overseas trip departure event. Amid wavering support bases, it's urgent to first embrace even non-mainstream figures within the ruling party, rather than opposition figures, to strengthen unity." (하지만 지방선거에서 민심 척도인 서울시장 등 주요 거점을 패하면서 상황이 완전히 바뀌었다는 말이 나온다. 여권 관계자는 “시·도지사 숫자로는 이겼지만 질적으로는 져 ‘네 탓 공방’까지 벌어진 지금 분위기를 확 바꾸려면 역시 인사 혁신밖에 없다”며 “청와대 실장까지는 안 가더라도 수석과 비서관급 대폭 교체, 또는 장관 여럿을 바꾸는 중폭 개각이 필요하다는 의견이 대통령에게 많이 들어가고 있는 것으로 안다”고 했다. 다른 인사도 “대통령이 지방선거 결과에 ‘도대체 납득할 수 없다’고 하고, 그 직후 순방 출국 행사에 정청래 대표를 오지 말라 했다”며 “지지층이 동요하는 상황에서 야권 인사보다는 일단 여권 내 비명계까지 끌어안아 결속을 다지는 게 절실한 상황”이라고 했다.)

In this context, President Lee is set to deliver a public report on the outcomes of his European tour on the 19th. It is unusual for the president to take the microphone directly the day after returning from overseas. The presidential office side explained that the president had many solo-scheduled events, such as meeting with Pope Leo XIV without attendants and conversing with President Trump for nearly two hours during a dinner, making it "most effective for him to explain the outcomes directly." However, there are also interpretations that the president's direct appearance just over 10 days after the first-year anniversary press conference is aimed at stabilizing the unsettled ruling party atmosphere. Consequently, there is a possibility that the president may mention cabinet reshuffles and reorganization of the presidential office staff. (이런 가운데 이 대통령은 19일 유럽 순방 성과에 대한 대국민 보고에 나선다. 귀국 다음 날 대통령이 직접 마이크를 잡는 일은 이례적이다. 청와대 측은 이 대통령이 레오 14세 교황과 배석자 없이 만났고, 트럼프 대통령과도 만찬 때 2시간 가까이 대화하는 등 대통령이 혼자 소화한 일정이 많아 “성과를 직접 설명하는 것이 가장 효과적”이라고 했다. 하지만 취임 1주년 기자회견 뒤 10일여 만에 대통령이 또 직접 나서는 것을 두고 뒤숭숭한 여권 분위기를 다잡기 위한 것이라는 해석도 나왔다. 이에 따라 개각과 청와대 참모진 개편에 대한 대통령 언급이 나올 가능성도 있다.)

item.title: "Life is About Wobbling Along"... Did Jeong Bow Physically but Refuse to Bow in Heart? (“흔들리며 가는 게 인생”… 몸 굽힌 鄭, 마음은 안 굽혔나)
item.description:
"Life is About Wobbling Along"... Did Jeong Bow Physically but Refuse to Bow in Heart? (“흔들리며 가는 게 인생”… 몸 굽힌 鄭, 마음은 안 굽혔나)

President Lee Jae-myung returned to Seoul Airport on the 18th after concluding an 8-night, 10-day European tour. At the return ceremony, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a leading candidate for the next party leadership, and Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stood side by side to welcome President Lee. During the departure ceremony on the 9th, at the request of the presidential office, only Prime Minister Kim attended while Leader Jeong was absent, sparking interpretations that President Lee might be bolstering Prime Minister Kim ahead of the August party convention. The conflict between the party and the presidential office appears to be patched up for now, but there are predictions that tensions will escalate again if Leader Jeong formalizes his bid for re-election as party leader next week. <<> President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung descended from Air Force One at around 11:34 a.m. upon arriving at Seoul Airport. In front of the aircraft stood Prime Minister Kim, Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety Kim Min-jae, Leader Jeong, Floor Leader Han Byung-do, and Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, in that order. President Lee quickly passed by the welcoming party, shaking hands in the order they stood. He shook hands first with Prime Minister Kim, who bowed slightly, while President Lee made no particular remark. Leader Jeong bowed at a 90-degree angle to President Lee, who responded with "Good work." <<> At the party's general meeting held in the National Assembly, Leader Jeong continued to lower his stance and heap praise on President Lee. Emphasizing the outcomes of the recent tour, he said, "I express my respect and gratitude for the president's unprecedented diplomatic achievements, which fully displayed the demeanor of a world-class political leader." He added, "Now is the time for the party, government, and presidential office to unite tightly and actively participate in President Lee's efforts for peace and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula," and called for "solidarity and unity centered on President Lee." <<> During President Lee's tour, the conflict between pro-Lee and pro-Jeong factions reportedly reached its peak. After President Lee said in an interview marking his first anniversary in office on the 8th that "we lost where we should have won" while evaluating local elections, and it was known that he ordered Leader Jeong not to attend the next day's departure ceremony, the pro-Lee faction publicly demanded Leader Jeong's resignation as party leader and withdrawal from the party convention. Particularly during the tour, President Lee directly targeted Leader Jeong on X, stating, "The ruling party should use the language of responsibility rather than the language of conviction." Leader Jeong countered with the remark, "The regime is short, but the people are eternal," leading to comments within the ruling party that "the party-presidential office conflict is heading toward its worst." This situation coincided with a simultaneous drop in approval ratings for both the president and the ruling party. <<> Leader Jeong is expected to step down as party leader next week while announcing his stance on running in the party convention. On his way to the general meeting that day, Leader Jeong was heard conversing with fellow party lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae, saying, "Where is there a life that doesn't waver? Isn't life all about wobbling and getting soaked along the way?" This is said to be a reference to poet Do Jong-hwan's poem 'The Flower That Blooms While Swaying.' A Democratic Party official commented, "This seems to show his intention to seek re-election as party leader." <<> It is reported that if Leader Jeong pursues re-election as party leader, he will emphasize again that he aims to become a party leader dedicated to the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. He is expected to frame the competition against rival Prime Minister Kim as a "pro-Jeong vs. pro-Seok" dynamic rather than an "anti-Lee" stance. A ruling party official said, "Leader Jeong's camp will try to create a competitive structure within the party centered on the success of the Lee administration, but the key is how much they can dilute the already established pro-Lee vs. pro-Jeong confrontation." <<> Within the Democratic Party, pressure for Leader Jeong to withdraw from the race continues. Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won appeared on radio and said, "In the current situation, it seems Leader Jeong will definitely go for the party convention even if it kills him," adding, "If so, the Lee-Jeong conflict will only intensify, never diminish." Park again urged Leader Jeong to withdraw, stating, "If Leader Jeong runs, the people and party members will judge him." Pro-Lee lawmaker Lee Geon-tae wrote on Facebook, "Leader Jeong's 90-degree bow was a display of political technique to the president," and said, "President Lee dislikes such protocol. Leader Jeong can't be unaware of that. Please stop it. I'm tired of hearing lip service about being pro-Lee." (이재명 대통령이 8박 10일간 유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 서울공항을 통해 귀국했다. 이날 귀국 행사에는 차기 당권 주자인 김민석 국무총리와 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 나란히 나와 이 대통령을 맞이했다. 지난 9일 출국 행사 때는 청와대 요청으로 정 대표는 빠지고 김 총리만 나오면서, 이 대통령이 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 김 총리에게 힘을 실어주는 것 아니냐는 해석이 나왔었다. 당청 갈등은 일단 봉합되는 듯 보이지만 정 대표가 다음주 당대표 연임 도전을 공식화하면 다시 고조될 것이란 전망도 나온다.)

item.title: Gyeonggi Lawmakers from People Power Party Postpone Press Conference Calling for Jang Dong-hyuk's Resignation... Jang Visits Hospital and Is Admitted (국힘 경기 의원들 ‘장동혁 사퇴’ 회견 보류… 張은 병원 찾았다 입원)
item.description:
Gyeonggi Lawmakers from People Power Party Postpone Press Conference Calling for Jang Dong-hyuk's Resignation... Jang Visits Hospital and Is Admitted (국힘 경기 의원들 ‘장동혁 사퇴’ 회견 보류… 張은 병원 찾았다 입원)

Lawmakers from the People Power Party (PPP) in the Gyeonggi region had prepared a press conference calling for the resignation of party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, but abruptly postponed it. This followed the last-minute decision by lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo (Gyeonggi, Seongnam Bundang-gu A) and Kim Eun-hye (Gyeonggi, Seongnam Bundang-gu B) to skip the event. (국민의힘 경기 지역 의원들이 장동혁 대표의 사퇴 촉구 기자회견을 준비했다가 돌연 보류했다. 안철수(경기 성남분당갑)·김은혜(경기 성남분당을) 의원이 막판 불참하기로 한 데 따른 것이다.)

PPP Gyeonggi Provincial Party Chairman Kim Sun-kyo (Gyeonggi, Yeoju-Yangpyeong), along with lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo, Yoo Eui-dong (Gyeonggi, Pyeongtaek B), Kim Sung-won (Gyeonggi, Dongducheon-Yangju-Yeoncheon B), Song Seok-joon (Gyeonggi, Icheon), Kim Eun-hye, and Kim Yong-tae (Gyeonggi, Pocheon-Gapyeong) had scheduled a press conference at the National Assembly's Communication Center at 1:30 PM on the 18th to urge Chairman Jang's resignation. The lawmakers reportedly shared a consensus on the need to reform the party based on the results of the June 3 local elections. (국민의힘 김선교(경기 여주·양평) 경기도당위원장과 안철수·유의동(경기 평택을)·김성원(경기 동두천·양주·연천을)·송석준(경기 이천)·김은혜·김용태(경기 포천·가평) 의원은 18일 오후 1시 30분 국회 소통관에서 장 대표 사퇴 촉구 기자회견을 예고했다. 의원들은 6·3 지방선거 결과를 바탕으로 당을 쇄신해야 한다는 데 공감대가 있었다고 한다.)

However, during the preparation of the press statement ahead of the conference, lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo and Kim Eun-hye reportedly expressed their intention to withdraw from the statement. In a media notice, Rep. Ahn stated, "There were differences in the direction of the statement." The two lawmakers apparently disagreed on some wording and the timing of the announcement. Some within the party speculated, "The two lawmakers, who are considering running in the next party convention, may have taken into account the backlash from the hardline supporters backing Chairman Jang." The lawmakers said they plan to coordinate their opinions and re-pursue the press conference. (하지만 기자회견 전 회견문을 준비하는 과정에서 안철수·김은혜 의원이 성명에 불참하겠다는 입장을 밝혔다고 한다. 안 의원은 언론 공지에서 “회견문의 방향성에 이견이 있었다”고 했다. 두 의원은 일부 문안, 발표 시점 등에 의견이 달랐다고 한다. 당 일각에선 “차기 전당대회 출마를 검토하는 두 의원이 장 대표를 지지하는 강성 지지층 반발까지 염두에 둔 것 같다”는 얘기도 나왔다. 의원들은 의견을 조율해 기자회견을 재추진하겠다는 입장이다.)

At a PPP Supreme Council meeting held that morning, Supreme Council member Woo Jae-jun again called for the leadership's resignation. "I hope the leadership ends its term at least by autumn, when the issue with the Election Commission is resolved," Woo said. The PPP leadership is dissolved if four of the five elected Supreme Council members (Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-soo, Kim Jae-won, Yang Hyang-ja, and Woo Jae-jun) resign. Currently, Yang Hyang-ja and Woo Jae-jun are in favor of resignation. Meeting with reporters, Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook said, "As a mainstream trend within the party, talk of the leadership resigning likely won't come up for a while." Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won did not attend the meeting that day. (이날 오전 열린 국민의힘 최고위원 회의에선 우재준 최고위원이 지도부 사퇴를 재차 주장했다. 우 최고위원은 “지도부가 선관위 사태가 마무리되는 때에, 적어도 가을 전에는 임기를 종료했으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부는 선출직 최고위원 5명(신동욱·김민수·김재원·양향자·우재준) 중 4명이 사퇴하면 해산하는데, 현재 양향자·우재준 최고위원이 사퇴 찬성 입장이다. 신동욱 최고위원은 기자들과 만나 “당 내부의 주류적 흐름으로는 당분간 지도부 사퇴 얘기가 나오지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 김재원 최고위원은 이날 회의에 불참했다.)

Former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min, appearing on Channel A, said of Chairman Jang, "He has never made serious efforts toward rebuilding conservatism since the martial law and impeachment," adding, "It's only a matter of time before he is replaced." Yoo argued the "proper method" is to hold a party convention to discuss the leadership that will handle the next general election, rather than forming an emergency committee. (유승민 전 의원은 채널A에 출연해 장 대표에 대해 “계엄과 탄핵 이후 보수 재건을 향해 진지한 노력을 별로 해 본 적 없는 리더십”이라며 “교체되는 건 시간 문제”라고 했다. 유 전 의원은 비상대책위원회를 구성하기보단 전당대회를 열어 다음 총선을 치를 리더십을 논의해야 하는 것이 ‘정공법’이라고 했다.)

Amid this, Chairman Jang visited a hospital that day due to overwork and was admitted on the recommendation of medical staff. Jang, who had staged a hunger strike in January demanding the introduction of "dual special counsel probes" (for the Unification Church and the Democratic Party's nomination bribery probe), has reportedly not fully recovered his health. (이런 가운데 장 대표는 이날 과로로 병원을 찾았다가 의료진 권유로 입원했다. 장 대표는 지난 1월 ‘쌍특검(통일교·민주당 공천 뇌물 특검)’ 도입을 요구하는 단식을 한 후 몸 상태가 완전히 회복되지 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Will a Korea-US summit 'golf diplomacy' come to pass? President Lee: "Trump proposed it, seems we need to prepare." (한미 정상 ‘골프 외교’ 이뤄질까… 李 “트럼프가 제안, 준비해야 할 듯”)
item.description:
Will a Korea-US summit 'golf diplomacy' come to pass? President Lee: "Trump proposed it, seems we need to prepare." (한미 정상 ‘골프 외교’ 이뤄질까… 李 “트럼프가 제안, 준비해야 할 듯”)

President Lee Jae-myung, attending the G7 summit in Evian, France, revealed on the 17th (local time) that he received a 'golf round' proposal from U.S. President Donald Trump during the official dinner. (프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7(7국) 정상회의에 참석한 이재명 대통령은 17일(현지 시각) 공식 만찬 때 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게서 ‘골프 라운딩’ 제안을 받았다고 밝혔다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day, President Lee wrote, "At yesterday's dinner, (President Trump) brought up golf and said he wanted to play golf with my wife and me, so my wife made a pinky promise with him," adding, "As we parted after today's lunch, he insisted we must definitely play golf together. I thought it was just a passing comment, but it seems I need to get ready." President Lee sat next to President Trump during the official dinner on the 16th and also joined him for the working lunch on the 17th, where the topic of golf reportedly came up. <<> After taking office in June of last year, President Lee made a promise during his first phone call with President Trump to have a 'round for the alliance,' after they shared their golf skills. It was reported that President Lee took his first vacation after his inauguration in August of that year to Cheonghadae, the presidential retreat on Jeodo Island in Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, where he engaged in 'special training' at the attached 9-hole golf course. Although a golf round did not materialize during the Korea-U.S. summit at the end of August, it was said that President Lee occasionally practiced golf in Korea afterward in preparation for a potential round with the U.S. president. With President Trump once again bringing up golf, speculation is growing that a golf round between the two leaders might become a reality. President Trump is a self-proclaimed 'golf fanatic' and has played rounds with foreign leaders like former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe to build camaraderie. <<> President Lee also disclosed that he received a 'signature pen' as a gift from President Trump. "I think it might be because he remembered receiving the pen I used during our first summit," President Lee said. When President Lee visited the White House in August of last year and wrote in the guestbook, President Trump showed interest in his pen, and President Lee gave it to him on the spot. Subsequently, orders for the pen's manufacturer surged, leading to a temporary halt in sales. <<> Meanwhile, the presidential office announced that President Lee will host a dinner at the presidential office on the 23rd, inviting diplomatic envoys from 118 countries residing in Korea and representatives from 30 international organizations. (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “어제 만찬 때 (트럼프 대통령이) 골프 얘기를 하며 우리 부부와 골프를 함께 하겠다고 해 아내가 손가락 걸고 약속을 받았다”며 “오늘 오찬 후 헤어지면서 다시 골프를 꼭 함께 하자고 했다. 지나가는 말인 줄 알았는데 준비를 해야 할 것 같다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 16일 공식 만찬 때 트럼프 대통령 옆자리에 앉았고, 17일 업무 오찬도 함께했는데 여기서 골프 얘기가 나왔다는 것이다.)

item.title: Conditions for Wartime Operational Control Transition… U.S. Congress Tightens Legal Requirements (전시작전권 전환 조건… 美의회, 까다롭게 법 고친다)
item.description:
Conditions for Wartime Operational Control Transition… U.S. Congress Tightens Legal Requirements (전시작전권 전환 조건… 美의회, 까다롭게 법 고친다)

The U.S. Senate’s ‘National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2027,’ released on the 16th (local time), has strengthened safeguards compared to last year to prevent a hasty transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) without reflecting the U.S. military’s opinions. While the South Korean government has stated that the OPCON transition is a “political decision” and believes it could be possible as early as next year, analysts suggest that the likelihood of a delay has increased. (미국 연방 상원이 16일(현지 시각) 공개한 ‘2027 회계연도 국방수권법안(NDAA)’에서 미군의 의견이 반영되지 않은 채 섣불리 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환이 이뤄지는 일이 없도록 하기 위한 견제 장치를 지난해보다 더욱 강화한 것으로 나타났다. 우리 정부는 전작권 전환이 “정치적 결정”이라며 이르면 내년에도 가능하다고 판단하고 있는 것으로 알려졌지만, 제동이 걸릴 가능성이 커졌다는 분석이 나온다.)

In the recently adopted FY2027 NDAA, the Senate Armed Services Committee stipulated that the Secretary of War (Secretary of Defense) must certify to Congress at least 60 days before the OPCON transition that the transfer aligns with U.S. national interests and that appropriate consultations have been conducted with South Korea, Japan, as well as all allies participating in the United Nations Command, including the UK and Canada. (미 상원 군사위원회는 최근 채택한 2027 NDAA에서 전작권 전환이 미국의 국익에 부합하며 한국, 일본은 물론 영국, 캐나다 등 유엔사에 참여 중인 모든 동맹국과 적절한 협의를 거쳤다는 점을 전쟁부(국방부) 장관이 전작권 전환 60일 전까지 의회에 인증해야 한다고 규정했다.)

Last year’s NDAA required this certification process only when the OPCON transition was carried out “in a manner deviating from the plan agreed upon by South Korea and the U.S.,” but this clause has been removed. This means that even if the transition proceeds according to the existing bilateral agreement, the certification and reporting procedures to the U.S. Congress must still be followed. (지난해 NDAA는 전작권 전환이 ‘한미가 합의했던 계획에서 벗어나는 방법’으로 이뤄질 때만 이런 인증 절차가 필요하다고 했지만, 이 대목은 삭제됐다. 한미가 기존 합의대로 전작권 전환을 하더라도, 미국 의회에 대한 인증·보고 절차를 밟으라는 것이다.)

This year’s bill also includes a new provision requiring the U.S. Secretary of War to report to Congress every 90 days, from March 1, 2026, through 2030, on the bilateral roadmap for implementing the OPCON transition plan. It explicitly mandates that these reports include the current assessments of the U.S. Pacific Commander and the Commander of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) on the military conditions necessary for the transition, thereby emphasizing respect for the U.S. military’s opinions. (올해 법안에는 내년 3월 1일부터 2030년까지 매 90일마다 미국 전쟁부 장관이 전작권 전환 계획 이행을 위한 한미 간의 로드맵을 미국 의회에 보고하라는 조항도 신설됐다. 이 보고서에 미 태평양사령관과 주한미군사령관이 전작권 전환에 필요한 군사적 조건을 현재 어떻게 평가하고 있는지를 반드시 포함하라고 해, 미군의 의견을 존중하겠다는 점도 분명히 했다.)

◇ In Response to South Korea’s Fast-Track OPCON Transition… U.S. Senate Sends ‘U.S. Military Opinions Matter’ Message (◇한국의 전작권 전환 속도전에… 美상원 ‘미군 의견이 중요’ 메시지)

The U.S. Senate’s strengthening of congressional certification and reporting procedures for the OPCON transition in the FY2027 NDAA can be seen as an effort to prevent the transfer from being executed solely based on an agreement between political leaders of both countries without sufficient military conditions being met. The NDAA governs defense budget execution, meaning that if these procedures are not fulfilled, no funds can be allocated for the OPCON transition. (미국 상원이 ’2027 회계연도 국방수권법안(NDAA)‘에서 전작권 전환을 위한 의회 인증·보고 절차를 강화한 것은 군사적 조건이 충분히 갖춰지지 않았는데도 양국 정치 지도자 간의 합의만으로 전작권 전환이 이뤄지는 상황을 막겠다는 취지로 볼 수 있다. 국방수권법은 국방예산 집행에 관한 법안으로, 이 법에 규정된 절차를 충족하지 않으면 전작권 전환과 관련해서는 한 푼도 예산을 집행할 수 없다.)

As in last year’s NDAA, this year’s bill also requires the Secretary of War to include the results of an “independent military risk assessment” conducted by the USFK Commander, the Pacific Commander, and the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff when certifying the OPCON transition situation to Congress. This signifies that Congress will directly hear military opinions to control executive branch decisions. (상원 군사위는 지난해 NDAA와 마찬가지로 올해 법안에도 전쟁부 장관이 미 의회에 전작권 전환과 관련한 상황을 인증할 때 주한미군사령관, 태평양사령관, 합참의장이 실시한 ‘독립적 군사 위험 평가’ 결과를 포함해서 하라고 요구했다. 군의 의견을 의회가 직접 듣고 행정부 결정을 통제하겠다는 의미다.)

The South Korean government, which has been advocating for “the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) within President Lee Jae-myung’s term,” has appeared to accelerate efforts this year. Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek stated on the 14th, “By the end of this year, we will propose (to the presidents of both countries) to decide on Year X (the target year) for restoring OPCON.” President Lee said on the 26th of last month that even if OPCON were transferred tomorrow, there would be “no problem” and that South Korea must “quickly regain its status as a sovereign independent state as defined by the constitution.” (지난해부터 ‘이재명 대통령 임기 내 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환’을 주장해 온 우리 정부는 올 들어 한층 더 속도전에 나서는 모습을 보여 왔다. 안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 14일 “올해 말 (한미) 양국 대통령에게 건의해 전작권 회복 X년(목표 연도)을 결정하게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 26일 내일 전작권이 전환돼도 “아무 문제가 없다”며 “헌법이 정하는 자주독립 국가로서 위상을 신속하게 되찾아야 한다”고 했다.)

In contrast, U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth said on the 30th of last month regarding the OPCON transition, “I believe we need to find a balance that respects the military’s operational plans and the responsibilities that U.S. servicemembers have held for decades.” USFK Commander Xavier Brunson stated at a U.S. congressional hearing in April, “Political expediency must not be allowed to outpace conditions,” and revealed that “a roadmap to achieve those conditions by the second quarter of Fiscal Year 2029 (the first quarter of 2029 in South Korean terms) was submitted to the Department of the Army (U.S. Department of Defense).” According to this roadmap, the South Korean government’s envisioned “transition as early as next year” would be difficult. (반면 피트 헤그세스 미국 전쟁부 장관은 지난달 30일 전작권 전환과 관련해 “미군의 작전 계획과 미군 장병들이 수십 년간 지녀온 책임이 존중되는 지점에서 균형을 찾아야 한다고 생각한다”고 했다. 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 지난 4월 미 의회 청문회에서 “정치적 편의주의가 조건을 앞질러서는 안 된다”며 “2029회계연도 2분기(한국 기준 2029년 1분기) 이전까지 해당 조건을 달성하기 위한 로드맵을 전쟁부(미 국방부)에 제출했다”고 밝혔다. 이 로드맵대로라면 우리 정부가 구상하는 ‘이르면 내년 전환’은 어려운 일이다.)

However, shortly thereafter, Cheong Wa Dae National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated, “While we cannot discount the military aspects of the OPCON issue, this is fundamentally a matter of political decision. Ultimately, the decision will be made by the top leadership of both governments.” This remark was interpreted as suggesting that President Lee Jae-myung could persuade U.S. President Donald Trump to expedite the OPCON transition. (하지만 그 직후 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 “전작권 문제에서 군사적 측면을 물론 경시할 수 없지만, 이건 기본적으로 정치적인 결정의 문제”라며 “결국 결정은 양국 정부 수뇌부들이 내리게 되는 것”이라고 했다. 이재명 대통령이 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령을 설득해 전작권 전환을 앞당길 수 있다는 취지로 해석되는 발언이었다.)

The U.S. Senate’s demand in the FY2027 NDAA that the U.S. Pacific Commander and USFK Commander submit evaluation reports on the OPCON transition to Congress every 90 days from March 2026 through 2030 could serve as a powerful check on such “political decisions.” The Senate required these reports to include assessments of: ① how much military capability South Korea has acquired and operationally deployed to lead combined defense; ② whether the alliance’s comprehensive response capability against North Korea’s nuclear and missile threats is sufficient; and ③ whether the security environment on the Korean Peninsula and the Indo-Pacific region is suitable for a stable OPCON transition. This shows Congress’s intent to directly oversee whether military issues exist even if the transition proceeds. (미국 상원이 2027 NDAA를 통해 미 태평양사령관과 주한미군사령관에게 내년 3월부터 2030년까지 90일 단위로 전작권 전환 관련 평가 보고서를 의회에 제출하라고 요구한 것은 이런 ‘정치적 결정’에 대한 강력한 통제 장치가 될 수 있다. 미국 상원은 이 보고서에 ①한국이 연합 방위를 주도하기 위해 필요한 군사적 역량을 얼마나 획득하고 실전 배치했는지 ②북한의 핵·미사일 위협에 대응하기 위한 동맹의 포괄적 대응 역량은 충분한지 ③한반도와 인도·태평양의 안보 환경이 안정적인 전작권 전환에 적합한지에 대한 평가 등을 담으라고 요구했다. 전작권 전환을 해도 군사적 문제가 없는지 직접 챙겨 보겠다는 것이다.)

The U.S. Senate also established a safeguard that, similar to the OPCON transition, requires the Secretary of War to undergo prior congressional certification and reporting procedures if USFK troop levels are reduced below the current 28,500. (미 상원은 주한미군을 현재 수준인 2만8500명 이하로 감축할 때도 전작권 전환과 마찬가지로 사전에 전쟁부 장관이 의회에 대한 인증·보고 절차를 밟아야 한다고 해서 견제 장치를 뒀다.)

In the report language supporting the NDAA, the U.S. Senate also addressed South Korea’s acquisition of nuclear-powered submarines, agreed upon at last year’s summit between the two countries. While supporting the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines, it demands a report to Congress by February 1, 2026, analyzing the impact of submarine operation costs on achieving OPCON transition goals. This reflects concerns in some U.S. quarters that even if South Korea drastically increases defense spending to 3.5% of its GDP, simultaneously pursuing costly nuclear-powered submarine construction and the OPCON transition may not provide sufficient military assets for South Korea’s wartime operational leadership. (NDAA를 뒷받침하는 지침서(Report Language)에서 미국 상원은 한미가 지난해 정상회담에서 합의한 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입 문제도 거론했다. 원잠 도입은 지지하지만, 원잠 운용 비용이 전작권 전환 목표 달성에 미치는 영향을 분석해 내년 2월 1일까지 의회에 보고하라는 것이다. 미국 일각에는 한국이 국내총생산(GDP)의 3.5%까지 국방비를 급격히 증액하더라도 막대한 비용이 소요되는 원잠 건조와 동시에 전작권 전환을 추진하면, 한국군의 전시작전 주도에 필요한 군사 자산을 확보하기에 충분하지 않다는 우려가 있는데 이것이 반영된 셈이다.)

The report language also expresses particular concern about “the Chinese Communist Party’s malign influence” in South Korea and demands that the Secretary of War submit a related report to Congress by May 1, 2026. This includes assessing how China’s malign influence poses human intelligence and national security risks to USFK. (이 지침서에는 ‘중국공산당의 한국 내 악성 영향력’ 공작에 각별한 우려를 표명하며, 전쟁부 장관에게 내년 5월 1일까지 의회에 관련 보고를 하라고 요구하는 내용도 담겼다. 중국의 악성 영향력이 주한미군에 인적 정보, 국가 안보 리스크를 얼마나 야기하는지 등을 평가해 의회에 브리핑하라는 것이다.)

Since the NDAA requires both the House and Senate to pass their respective versions and then reconcile differences into a unified bill, the Senate bill’s wording may be subject to change. However, the bill passed by the House Armed Services Committee on the 5th also includes a provision requiring the Secretary of War to confirm to Congress that the OPCON transition aligns with U.S. interests and that consultations with allies have been completed if the transition proceeds differently from a pre-agreed plan. (국방수권법은 상·하원이 각각 법안을 통과시킨 후 서로 문안을 조율하는 과정을 거쳐 통합 법안을 만들기에 상원 법안 문구가 수정될 가능성은 있다. 다만 지난 5일 하원 군사위가 통과시킨 법안에도 전작권 전환이 사전에 합의된 계획과 다르게 추진되면 전쟁부 장관이 그것이 미국의 이익에 부합하며 동맹국과 협의를 마쳤다는 점을 의회에 확인해야 한다는 조항이 있다.)

item.title: Steel, U.S. Ambassador Nominee to South Korea, Takes Post After Two Months (스틸 주한 美대사 지명 두달만에 부임)
item.description:
Steel, U.S. Ambassador Nominee to South Korea, Takes Post After Two Months (스틸 주한 美대사 지명 두달만에 부임)

The confirmation of Michelle Steel (71, Korean name Park Eun-joo) as the U.S. ambassador nominee to South Korea passed the U.S. Senate on the 17th (local time), paving the way for her to assume the post soon. The Senate approved Steel's nomination with 55 votes in favor and 39 against. The South Korean government is also known to have granted its agrément to Steel. Thus, the personnel procedures on both the U.S. and South Korean sides have essentially been completed about two months after Steel was nominated on April 13. (미셸 스틸(71·한국명 박은주) 주한 미국 대사 후보자의 인준안이 17일(현지 시각) 미 연방 상원을 통과해 조만간 부임할 전망이다. 미 상원은 이날 스틸 후보자의 인준안을 찬성 55표, 반대 39표로 가결 처리했다. 한국 정부도 아그레망(주재국 부임 동의)을 스틸 후보자에게 부여한 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 4월 13일 스틸 후보자가 지명된 후 두 달여 만에 한미 양측의 인사 절차가 사실상 마무리된 셈이다.)

This is expected to fill the vacancy in the U.S. ambassadorship to South Korea, which has been empty for about a year and a half since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg, appointed under the previous Biden administration, left in January last year. This marks the first formal appointment of a U.S. ambassador to South Korea since the launch of the second Trump administration. Until now, the position had been maintained in an acting capacity. (이에 따라 지난해 1월 전임 조 바이든 행정부에서 임명된 필립 골드버그 전 대사가 이임한 후 비어 있었던 주한 미국 대사직 공백도 약 1년 6개월 만에 해소될 전망이다. 트럼프 2기 행정부 출범 후 정식으로 주한 미국 대사가 임명되는 것은 이번이 처음이다. 지금까지는 대행 체제로 유지됐다.)

Born in Seoul in 1955, Ambassador Steel spent her middle and high school years in Japan before immigrating to the U.S. in 1975, coming from a family of immigrants. She becomes the second Korean-American U.S. ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim during the Obama administration. Having served in elected positions such as the California Board of Equalization, she served as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives for four years starting in 2021. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 대사는 중·고교 시절을 일본에서 보내고 1975년 미국으로 이주한 이민자 가족 출신이다. 스틸 대사는 오바마 행정부 시절 성 김 전 대사 이후 두 번째 한국계 주한 미국 대사가 된다. 캘리포니아주 조세형평위원 등 선출직을 거쳐 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원의원을 지냈다.)

Meanwhile, on the 18th, Kim Yo-jong, Vice Department Director of the North Korean Workers' Party, issued a statement regarding the G7 joint statement expressing concerns about North Korea's nuclear and missile programs, stating, "We express strong dissatisfaction and regret over the G7's act of overstepping its authority, which is a direct infringement on our state constitution, and resolutely denounce and reject it in the most unequivocal terms." Kim Yo-jong also said, "Our nuclear weapons, as a self-defensive and countermeasure means, will remain unchanged in identity and permanence," and "Maintaining nuclear weapons is our core interest that must be upheld, and 'denuclearization' is an unyielding line that can never be crossed." (한편 김여정 북한 노동당 부장이 북핵·미사일에 대한 우려를 표명한 G7(7국) 정상 공동성명에 대해 “우리 국가 헌법에 대한 직접적 침해가 되는 G7의 월권 행위에 강한 불만과 유감을 표시하며 이를 가장 명백한 어조로 단호히 규탄 배격한다”는 담화를 18일 발표했다. 김여정은 또 “자위적, 대응적 수단으로서의 우리의 핵은 정체성도 존속성도 영구불변할 것”이라며 “핵 보유는 반드시 고수해야 할 우리의 핵심 이익이며 ‘비핵화’는 절대로 넘어설 수 없는 불퇴의 선”이라고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting; Independent Han Dong-hoon Joins (국힘, 사전투표 폐지법 발의…무소속 한동훈 동참)
item.description:
People Power Party Proposes Bill to Abolish Early Voting; Independent Han Dong-hoon Joins (국힘, 사전투표 폐지법 발의…무소속 한동훈 동참)

On the 18th, Rep. Park Dae-chul of the People Power Party proposed a revision to the Public Official Election Act that would abolish early voting and extend the main voting period to two days. This marks the first time a bill to abolish the early voting system has been introduced. (국민의힘 박대출 의원이 18일 사전투표를 폐지하고 본투표를 이틀로 늘리는 내용의 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 사전투표제 폐지 법안이 발의된 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Co-sponsors include 25 lawmakers, such as senior lawmakers in their third to fourth terms like Kim Sang-hoon, Yoon Young-seok, Kim Sung-won, Kim Jung-jae, and Song Eon-seok; party leadership including Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook; and members of the "Alternative and Future" faction like Lee Man-hee and Kwon Young-jin. (공동 발의자로 김상훈·윤영석·김성원·김정재·송언석 의원 등 3~4선 중진 의원, 신동욱 최고위원 등 당 지도부, ‘대안과 미래’ 소속인 이만희·권영진 의원 등 25명의 의원이 참여했다.)

The amendment focuses on abolishing the early voting system and instead extending the main voting day from the current one day to two days. It also includes the reintroduction of an "absentee voting system," allowing voters who cannot participate in the main voting to vote in advance for two days starting four days before the election, provided they report this in advance. (개정안은 사전투표제를 폐지하는 대신, 본 투표일을 현행 하루에서 이틀로 늘리는 내용을 골자로 한다. 본투표에 참여하지 못하는 유권자는 사전에 신고한 경우 선거일 4일 전부터 이틀간 미리 투표할 수 있도록 하는 ‘부재자투표제’를 재도입하는 내용도 담겼다.)

Rep. Park stated on Facebook, "Under the current system, I am deeply concerned that not only early voting but even thorough election management itself may exceed the National Election Commission's operational capabilities. The fairness and credibility, which are the essence of elections, are being significantly compromised, and we can no longer leave this situation unattended. We must break this 'chain of distrust' that causes immense social costs and conflicts." (박 의원은 페이스북에 “지금 체제로는 사전투표는 물론이고 철저한 선거관리 자체가 선관위의 업무 역량을 넘어서는 것은 아닌지 매우 우려된다”며 “선거의 본질인 공정성과 신뢰성이 크게 훼손되는 상황을 더는 방치해선 안 된다. 극심한 사회적 비용과 갈등을 초래하는 이 ‘불신의 사슬’을 끊어내야 한다”고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the People Power Party, also joined this proposal. (이번 발의에는 국민의힘에서 제명된 무소속 한동훈 의원도 동참했다.)

item.title: "You Cannot Move the Korean Military Like That"… Paik Sun-yup's Ultimatum That Moved Eisenhower (“그렇게는 한국군을 움직일 수 없소”… 아이젠하워를 움직인 백선엽의 협박)
item.description:
"You Cannot Move the Korean Military Like That"… Paik Sun-yup's Ultimatum That Moved Eisenhower ( “그렇게는 한국군을 움직일 수 없소”… 아이젠하워를 움직인 백선엽의 협박)

At that time, Gyeongmudae was very cramped. The reception room in that small presidential office was too small for the top three officials and all cabinet members to stand together. Nevertheless, from early morning, following the president's orders, South Korea's highest-ranking dignitaries waited and waited in the reception room of Gyeongmudae for the visit of U.S. President-elect Dwight D. Eisenhower. When lunchtime came, the dignitaries went out in small groups to grab a meal. At that time, Gyeongmudae lacked facilities to host so many guests. <<> After having lunch in small groups, the dignitaries returned to Gyeongmudae. The silent wait continued. Eisenhower, who was staying at the 8th Army headquarters in Dongsung-dong, was soon expected to head to Yeouido Airfield to depart for home. He had not mentioned visiting Gyeongmudae at all. Emphasizing that his visit to Korea was unofficial as a president-elect, he seemed to have no intention of paying a formal visit to Gyeongmudae. <<> President Syngman Rhee's expression grew noticeably worse. According to Paik Sun-yup's memoirs, "It wasn't quite anxiety, but his face betrayed a mix of regret and anger toward Eisenhower, who might soon return home without visiting Gyeongmudae following the welcome ceremony at Gwanghwamun." <<> The president's silence continued, and the atmosphere in the Gyeongmudae reception room grew heavier. President Rhee summoned Kim Tae-seon, the then Mayor of Seoul. Mayor Kim was a rare individual at the time with study-abroad experience in the U.S. He was a valuable talent who could communicate with high-ranking U.S. officials in English. President Rhee instructed Mayor Kim to go to the 8th Army headquarters in Dongsung-dong. <<> Everyone's hopes were pinned on this. However, when Mayor Kim returned from Dongsung-dong to Gyeongmudae, his expression was very dark. He reported back, "I couldn't even get through the main gate of the 8th Army headquarters in Dongsung-dong."
